newsitem.title: USA: California woman dies with Kevorkian present.
newsitem.headline: California woman dies with Kevorkian present.

text.p: Dr. Jack Kevorkian assisted in the suicide of a 60-year-old Californian woman, according to a statement read on Saturday by Kevorkian's lawyer on WWJ-Radio in Detroit.
The death of Isabelle Correa comes less than 24 hours after police broke up a counselling session between Correa and Kevorkian at a hotel outside Detroit.
"Despite the best efforts of the thugs, Isabelle Correa through the help of Dr. Jack Kevorkian, ended her years of suffering today," Kevorkian lawyer Geoffrey Fieger said in the statement.
Correa's death is the 40th time Kevorkian has publicly admitted being present at a death since 1990. She suffered from a spinal cord disease and was in constant pain, according to Fieger.
Acting on a tip that Kevorkian was going help Correa die, police raided a suburban Detroit hotel room Friday evening and broke up the counselling session between Kevorkian and Correa.
Correa, of Fresno, California, told reporters on Friday she had gone to Michigan to end her life with Kevorkian's help.
